overall: The AG found the Saugus School Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by releasing March 16, 2017 executive session minutes that lacked substantive detail and omitted the meeting time; it ordered compliance and amended minutes.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the March 16, 2017 executive session minutes on a teachers' collective bargaining discussion were insufficiently detailed.
allegations.key_passage: The minutes list the topics that were discussed— teaching time, insurance, etc.—but they do not provide a substantive summary of the Committee's conversations on these topics.

allegations.summary: The AG noted, on its own review, that the March 16, 2017 executive session minutes omitted the time of the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Further, the minutes do not list the time of the meeting.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Within 30 days of receipt, amend the March 16, 2017 executive session minutes to include the missing detail.
Notify the AG's office in writing of compliance once the amendments are complete (940 CMR 29.07(4)).
remedy_passage: We order the Committee's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and we caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
